model.inertia_formula: J_k=(4/3)*J0*sin(gamma-2*pi*k/3)^2, k=1,2,3; existing helper convention, unsorted axes
model.Hamiltonian: H=sum_k (I_right,k x 1 - 1 x j_k)^2/(2 J_k) + C*(1 x Q_j(gamma))
model.right_body: I_right=(Jx,-Jy,Jz) with anomalous commutators; particle j has ordinary commutators
model.charge: q20=cos(gamma), q2,+/-2=sin(gamma)/sqrt(2), q2,+/-1=0; each times fermion identity; Qcal=1
model.space: bare rotor-product |I,K> x |j,Omega>, no pairing, no Nambu doubling or eta projection
model.projection: H_D2=P_I^dagger H_product P_I; EM_RME=V_f^dagger P_f^dagger T_product P_i V_i

closure_scope.registry: All physical D2 states at each I=1/2..15/2, all their magnetic partners; complete=True means complete only inside this explicitly projected finite window.
closure_scope.initial_exactness: For initial I=11/2, rank2 requires only I_a,I_b=7/2..15/2 in closed q2/q3 loops. All their states and middle RMEs are retained. Thus these moments equal infinite-rotor geometry for this initial spin.
closure_scope.not_claimed: Global completeness of the infinite rotor, or geometric closure for arbitrary initial spin near the window boundary.
closure_scope.direct_crosscheck: Build all five lab Q components by Wigner-Eckart in the complete magnetic finite-window representation, without 6j coefficients; contract at M=1/2 and stretched M=11/2.
closure_scope.operator_identity: Check initial-I M=1/2 block of QdotQ=1 and normalized cubic=cos(3gamma)*1 in the D2 coordinate basis, before selecting eigenstates.

high_I_boundary_check.boundary: Missing I=17/2,19/2 outer channels at this initial spin. Window is not globally complete.

boundary: Mathematical rigid-charge control in an unpaired model. No nuclear calibration, paired projection, physical Ba assignment, global infinite-rotor truncation claim, or novelty claim.
